locations.note: Harry works in Mr Taylor's photography shop until he signs up to go to the war as a photographer.
Harry photographs the Canadian trenches and crosses the battlefield under fire in the assault on the ridge, while Kurt goes over with the German defenders.
On leave between battles, Harry plays football and cards and dances in a cabaret.
Kurt, transferred to the Somme, searches the cemetery for his son Max's grave and checks dog tags in no man's land; Harry's camp before his flight with the documents is here too.
Kurt cuts the German radio while Harry shuts off a gas attack and frees the trapped Daniel, before German soldiers storm the church and Harry is taken prisoner.
Kurt is home on leave in the Black Forest village near his farm when Harry turns up, and the two look for medicine and build a balloon.
The last morning of the war, 11 November 1918, plays out near Nieuwpoort, where Barrett is stationed.

routes.name: Harry Lambert
routes.note: From a Toronto photo shop through Vimy, Paris and Passchendaele to the Black Forest and the last morning of the war.

routes.name: Kurt Waldner
routes.note: From the German lines at Vimy Ridge in search of his son, home to the Black Forest and back to the front.
